What to look for
  • The chat button (bottom corner) never covers the "Start a project" bar or the back-to-top button.
  • On a phone the chat opens as a full-height sheet; on a computer as a small panel.
  • Link buttons in answers open in a new tab. The bell in the chat header mutes the sound.
  • Write an e-mail address (for example name@example.com) to see the lead answer.
